ENGINE MECHANICAL (2JZ-GTE)  -  ENGINE UNIT

17.  DISCONNECT PS PRESSURE FEED HOSE FROM ENGINE
Remove the 2 clamp bolts and disconnect the pressure feed hose.

P11534

18.  DISCONNECT A/C COMPRESSOR WITHOUT DISCONNECTING HOSES
(a)  Remove the 2 bolts.

P11524

(b)  Disconnect the compressor connector.
(c)  Remove the bolt and nut.
(d)  Using a torx socket (E10), remove the stud bolt, and disconnect the compressor from the engine.
HINT:
Put aside the compressor, and suspend it securely.

P11540

19.  DISCONNECT ENGINE WIRE FROM COWL PANEL
(a)  Remove the bolt, and disconnect the ground strap.
(b)  Remove the 2 bolts, and disconnect the engine wire protector.

P11763

(c)  Remove the 2 bolts holding the engine wire retainer to the cowl panel.

P11761
